{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute response rate by arm on the full dataset (all 848 participants)
treatment_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

# Print all required numbers with exact values from computation
print(f'treatment_response_rate = {treatment_response_rate}')
print(f'control_response_rate = {control_response_rate}')
print(f'treatment_effect = {treatment_effect}')"}
